items.source:
Implementing objects can create AOP Alliance Interceptors from
custom advice types, enabling these advice types to be used
in the Spring AOP framework, which uses interception under the covers.
items.translation: 实现对象可以创建 AOP Alliance 拦截器，来自自定义的 Advice 类型，从而允许这些 Advice 类型在 Spring AOP 框架中使用，该框架底层使用拦截机制。

items.source:
There is no need for most Spring users to implement this interface;
do so only if you need to introduce more Advisor or Advice types to Spring.
items.translation: 大多数 Spring 用户无需实现此接口；仅在需要向 Spring 引入更多 Advisor 或 Advice 类型时才这样做。

items.source:
Don't worry about any Pointcut contained in the Advisor;
the AOP framework will take care of checking the pointcut.
items.translation: 无需担心 Advisor 中包含的任何切面；AOP 框架将负责检查该切面。

items.source: Does this adapter understand this advice object? Is it valid to invoke the getInterceptors method with an Advisor that contains this advice as an argument?
items.translation: 此适配器是否理解该建议对象？将包含此建议的 Advisor 作为参数调用 `getInterceptors` 方法是否有效？

items.source: advice - an Advice such as a BeforeAdvice
advisor - the Advisor. The supportsAdvice() method must have returned true on this object
items.translation: advisor - 顾问。该对象上的 supportsAdvice() 方法必须已返回 true。

items.source: whether this adapter understands the given advice object
items.translation: 该适配器是否理解给定的 Advice 对象

items.source:
an AOP Alliance interceptor for this Advisor. There's
no need to cache instances for efficiency, as the AOP framework
caches advice chains.
items.translation: 用于此 Advisor 的 AOP Alliance 拦截器。无需为了效率而缓存实例，因为 AOP 框架会缓存建议链。

items.source:
Return an AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor exposing the behavior of
the given advice to an interception-based AOP framework.
items.translation: 返回一个 AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor，将给定 advise 的行为暴露给基于拦截的 AOP 框架。
